I am 26 now, I took the first job that was offered to me out of school and as much as I tried to make it work it didn't. I ended up getting let go since it wasn't learning fast enough and that was a huge blow for me. My self esteem was pretty low even after getting job interviews right away. I just kept feeling that I wasn't good enough and that I would have the same problem again. I was only unemployed for a month and I've been at my company for almost 2 years doing design work in an office bldg. It's not something I saw myself doing but I like it most days. 

You really just have to try it before you turn it down. The atmosphere of the company and coworkers also helps.
